title: uipanels
summary: MSUI has the bounded host-confirmed Character/SpellBook transition, pure popup/fade/tab laws, and Party/Character/inset presentation repairs while preserving surface ownership and named differences. Twenty-two facts remain explicit implementation gaps; 124 implemented facts remain nonterminal, targetless where intentionally post-snapshot, and unverified live.

openItems.text: Implemented but needs live-session verification. Source-pinned runtime and deterministic checks implement the bounded invite popup, exact ordered effects, wire-body law, timeout, same-type override, direct-hide, and drag-off behavior.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI now routes normal CharacterFrame and SpellBookFrame opens through a host-confirmed ordinary zero-push left-seat replacement wedge with read-only preflights and post-callback census confirmation.
The frozen center/fullscreen seat setters, getters, and left-center movement semantics remain outside the bounded Character/SpellBook host adapter.
MSUI retains surface-owned Escape and close paths, but there is no authoritative frozen global CloseWindows/CloseAllWindows coordinator with the full center-ignore and ordered closure contract.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. The frozen UiPanels bag entry points are represented by the existing inventory-owned backpack/all-bag lifecycle and are owned canonically by the BagFrame packet.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. The existing GameMenu-owned open/micro-toggle/close path represents the frozen ToggleGameMenu entry point and retains its surface-owned sound and commit behavior.
The frozen world-item delete confirmation driver and its event-bound hidden frame are not integrated with MSUI's world inventory runtime.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. PanelTabLaw and active VanillaUi consumers preserve selected/disabled/hover state, the frozen max-width quirk, exact cap-preserving resize, parent-room clamp, and asynchronous settle decisions.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. VanillaTab renders the active/inactive PaperDoll three-slice art with fixed caps, exact UV ranges, selected rise, centered font routing, and hover highlight.
Implemented but needs live-session verification. VanillaInsetTab renders HelpFrame active/inactive three-slice art, fixed caps, bottom anchoring, button text, highlight, and state behavior.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. The Party-only popup renderer uses the frozen dialog backdrop/border, 290-wide GameFontHighlight text, 128x20 Accept/Decline buttons, exact button UVs, TOP -128 placement, and lifecycle handler ordering.
The frozen edit-box Enter callback, edit-box frame, input-border slices, anchors, focus, and production key handling remain absent from the Party-only popup renderer.
